assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production character sprite sheet for an existing top-down pixel-art Godot roguelike. The four supplied images are identity/appearance REFERENCES, not edit targets. Image 1 is boss 牛来 Niulai; image 2 is elite 豹拉 Baola; image 3 is a black wolf; image 4 is 小绳头 Little Ropehead snake. Create a new square transparent PNG sprite atlas, EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells. Dark outlines and crisp detailed pixel clusters, 3/4 overhead camera matching a cute action RPG, readable silhouettes at 60–140px height. Row 1 ALL FOUR frames are the SAME Niulai: bulky ORANGE anthropomorphic bull, huge rounded pale cream muzzle and chin, orange ears, tiny light horns, short orange tuft, low arched brows and small dark eyes matching image1, sturdy unclothed animal body. Poses left-to-right: idle, forward walking, lowered-head charge windup, powerful headfirst running charge. Row 2 ALL FOUR frames are the SAME Baola: upright yellow spotted leopard with tall rounded ears, broad gray-white belly, round black eyes and pink snout matching image2. Poses: idle, stalking, crouched pounce warning, pounce lunge. Row 3 ALL FOUR frames are the SAME quadruped BLACK wolf with icy white pale-blue chest and muzzle, yellow eyes and cream inner ears as image3. Poses: idle, running stride, crouched snarl, extended leap. Row 4 ALL FOUR frames are the SAME small thin olive-mottled SNAKE, PALE PINK underside, long lifted head and thin neck, no legs or arms, recognizable slim rope-like elongated silhouette from image4. Poses: coiled idle, slithering, reared-up aiming, venom spit. Every sprite full body, same size and foot baseline within its own row, safely inside its cell with generous transparent gutters. Keep all 16 sprites separate. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside sprites. No background, no terrain, no text, no labels, no grid borders, no shadows, no checkerboard, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production terrain and prop atlas for a top-down forest and meadow chapter in a pixel-art action roguelike. Create a transparent PNG, EXACT 4 columns by 3 rows of equal square cells, canvas landscape 4:3. Crisp detailed pixel clusters, dark outlines, natural woodland adventure palette. Row1 consists of FOUR FULLY OPAQUE square seamless terrain textures, edge to edge in each cell, STRICT OVERHEAD flat square no diamond: (1) sunny emerald meadow grass with tiny yellow flowers and clover, low contrast; (2) shaded dark forest loam with moss, little fallen leaves and tiny roots, low contrast; (3) trampled grass and warm earth track; (4) flat dark leafy moss. Row2: (1) one full leafy oak tree, compact foliage crown and clear trunk, 3/4 overhead; (2) one wide low mossy broken fallen log and stump for combat cover; (3) one wide low gray mossy boulder with small ferns for combat cover; (4) one tall ancient moss-wrapped standing stone with roots. Row3: (1) straight HORIZONTAL low forest boundary wall formed by gnarled roots, rocks and shrubs, long horizontal silhouette; (2) matching straight VERTICAL boundary wall, long vertical silhouette; (3) compact matching corner rock with a little fern; (4) flat OVERHEAD oval bare-soil clearing floor decal with sparse grass on edges for a bull boss arena, transparent exterior, no pedestal. Every prop isolated in its own cell with 24px transparent padding. Rows2 and3 must have actual alpha=0 around every object, no white matte and no checkerboard. No text, no labels, no dividers, no figures, no watermark.
